No, not with the promo applied. Free Standard shipping requires **$75 or more after discounts (before tax)**, and your cart would be $70 after the code. Standard shipping would be **$7.95**, which brings you to $77.95 before tax.

Using the code is still cheaper than skipping it. Without it, you'd pay $82 with free shipping, which is $4.05 more than $77.95.

**Leafy Plus** members get free Standard shipping with no minimum. It costs $59/year, so it probably only makes sense if you plan to order regularly. Express shipping is $14.95 and is never free, even for Plus members.
